    "(Tutorial_OpenMM_StructuresDictReporter)=\n",
    "# StructuresDictReporter\n",
    "\n",
    "*Capturing simulation trajectories in a lightweight Python structures dictionary.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The `StructuresDictReporter` class records coordinates, velocities, box vectors, and timestamps directly into a `molsysmt.StructuresDict` dictionary.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow this link for a detailed description of the input arguments, raised errors, and returned objects: {class}`molsysmt.third_party.openmm.reporters.StructuresDictReporter`.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "bb89063e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "Let's demonstrate using `StructuresDictReporter` with an OpenMM simulation:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "86f74782",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:39:42.672243Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:39:42.671983Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:39:49.408478Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:39:49.407375Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [

     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Captured trajectory frames: 3\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "\n",
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['Trp-Cage']['1l2y.h5msm'], to_form='molsysmt.MolSys')\n",
    "simulation = msm.convert(molsys, to_form='openmm.Simulation', temperature='300 K')\n",
    "\n",
    "reporter = msm.third_party.openmm.reporters.StructuresDictReporter(reportInterval=10)\n",
    "simulation.reporters.append(reporter)\n",
    "simulation.step(20)\n",
    "res = reporter.finalize()\n",
    "print('Captured trajectory frames:', len(res['coordinates']))"
   ]
  },
